_meta.description: Cascadia major infrastructure, environmental, and conservation projects planned or underway for the next decade (2025-2035). All budgets and links verified from public government sources.
_meta.disclaimer: Budget figures are from public planning documents as of September 2026. Projects evolve; verify with source links before reliance.

projects.name: Cascadia High-Speed Rail
projects.lead_agency: WSDOT (lead) + BC Ministry of Transportation + OR DOT
projects.description: 250 mph (400 km/h) high-speed rail connecting Vancouver BC, Seattle, and Portland. Would reduce Vancouver-Seattle travel to under 1 hour. Estimated 8:1 ROI, $355B economic growth over 30 years.
projects.uncertainties: Funding gap ($24-42B construction cost); cross-border governance structure; permitting timeline; political support across 3 jurisdictions

projects.name: Pacific Northwest Hydrogen Hub (PNWH2)
projects.lead_agency: DOE Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations + Pacific Northwest Hydrogen Association
projects.description: Regional hydrogen production, transport, and end-use infrastructure across WA, OR, MT. Eligible for up to $1B federal funding over 4 phases spanning 9 years. Produces clean hydrogen from renewables + natural gas with CCS.
key_milestones: Oct 2023: DOE selection for Regional Hydrogen Hub program
projects.uncertainties: Trump administration review of hydrogen hub funding (Oct 2025 — funding nixed then partially restored); private match requirements; market demand for hydrogen

projects.name: I-5 Interstate Bridge Replacement (Columbia River)
projects.description: Replacement of the aging I-5 bridge over the Columbia River with a new seismically-resilient, multi-modal crossing. Includes light rail extension to Vancouver WA. Cost estimate roughly doubled from $5B to ~$10B as design advanced.
key_milestones: 2025: RFQ for construction; $140M settlement with river users
projects.uncertainties: Cost escalation; federal funding share; light rail alignment disputes; seismic design requirements

projects.name: BC North Coast Transmission Line
projects.status: Funded in BC Budget 2026; construction starting 2025
projects.description: Nation-building transmission line delivering clean energy to power port expansions, LNG facilities, and mines on BC's North Coast. Cornerstone of BC's clean energy transition.
projects.uncertainties: Indigenous consultation timeline; construction cost inflation; LNG demand uncertainty

projects.name: Port of Seattle $5.6B Capital Plan
projects.description: 5-year capital plan to transform Seattle-Tacoma International Airport + maritime facilities. 2025 budget $1.1B promotes economic opportunity, climate action. Port catalyzed $39B regional economic benefit in 2025.
projects.uncertainties: Air traffic recovery; airline tenant agreements; federal grants

projects.name: Lower Snake River Dam Breaching Study
projects.status: WA state funded $800K Climate Act study + $750K outreach
projects.lead_agency: WA State Legislature + WSDOT + JTC independent review
projects.description: Study of transportation impacts of breaching 4 Lower Snake River dams to restore salmon runs. The 2025-27 operating budget allocated $800K from Climate Act funds + $750K for impacted-industry outreach. Breaching itself would cost ~$1.5B + require federal authorization.
projects.uncertainties: Federal authorization required (Congress); agriculture + navigation opposition; tribal treaty rights litigation; energy replacement cost ($300M-1B/yr)

projects.name: Columbia River Salmon Recovery Program
projects.status: Funded in 2026 federal budget (despite fears of cuts)
projects.description: Columbia River salmon recovery programs survived 2026 federal budget cycle better than feared. Army Corps salmon-restoration program allocated $66.7M. Supports tribal fishing rights, endangered species recovery, and Pacific Northwest fishing economy.
key_milestones: 2025: $1.5B cut to Army Corps threatened program
Feb 2026: Federal budget maintained Columbia salmon funding
Ongoing: Habitat restoration, hatchery reform, dam operations
projects.uncertainties: Annual federal budget battles; Snake River dam decision; climate impacts on ocean conditions; predator management

projects.name: Puget Sound Acquisition and Restoration (PSAR)
projects.lead_agency: WA State Recreation & Conservation Office + Puget Sound Partnership
projects.description: Funds salmon habitat protection and restoration projects around Puget Sound. 2026 grant round: 107 applications requesting $21.3M. 354 projects funded to date: 1,620 miles of river restored, 39 fish passage blockages removed.
projects.uncertainties: State biennial budget cycles; federal matching funds; project pipeline capacity

projects.name: BC Wildfire-Resilient Forests Program
projects.lead_agency: BC Ministry of Forests + BC Wildfire Service
projects.description: New investments in wildfire prevention, Indigenous forestry support, and logging contractor equipment. Response to record 2023 wildfire season ($1.1B emergency spend) and 2025 above-average season.
projects.uncertainties: Climate change worsening fire seasons; Indigenous consultation capacity; contractor workforce shortage

projects.name: WA Wildfire Response + Community Resilience
projects.lead_agency: WA Dept of Natural Resources + State Conservation Commission
projects.description: 2021 legislation committed $500M over 8 years for wildfire response, community resilience, forest health. Funding was threatened but restored April 2026. Includes $1.25M for Forest Health + Community Wildfire Resiliency Program.
projects.uncertainties: State biennial budget cycles; federal matching funds; climate-driven fire severity outpacing treatment capacity

projects.name: Indigenous Guardians Program (Canada)
projects.status: $173M+ dedicated to Guardians programs; new $340M round
projects.lead_agency: Environment and Climate Change Canada + Indigenous-led organizations
projects.description: Indigenous Guardians are trained Indigenous experts who monitor lands, restore ecosystems, and strengthen cultural connections. Canada announced $340M new funding for Indigenous-led conservation, with $173M+ for Guardians. Original $100M (2021) extends through 2026.
key_milestones: 2026+: Enhanced Nature Legacy sunset — successor program TBD
projects.uncertainties: Enhanced Nature Legacy sunsetting (successor program uncertain); Indigenous-led governance structures; long-term funding stability

projects.name: Port of Vancouver USA Capital Plan
projects.description: Annual capital budget of $112M (operating expenses $46.6M). Supports terminal upgrades, rail connections, and tenant facilities along Columbia River.
projects.uncertainties: Cargo volume fluctuations; tenant lease renewals; Columbia River channel maintenance
